create_LogNormal: create a LogNormal distribution from loc and scale parameters for PyTorch
sample_LogNormal: sample from a LogNormal distribution given loc and scale tensors
compute_LogNormal_mean: compute the mean of a LogNormal distribution from its loc and scale
compute_LogNormal_variance: compute the variance of a LogNormal distribution from its loc and scale
compute_LogNormal_entropy: compute the entropy of a LogNormal distribution
